title: PR #107: docs(control-plane): machine-readable roadmap, milestones and sprint loop
content:
State: closed
Merged: True

## Summary
- Add `control-plane/DELIVERY_REGISTRY.json` as machine-readable SSOT for roadmap, milestones, checkpoints, components, functions, sprints and TODOs.
- Add `docs/DELIVERY_CONTROL_PLANE.md` as the versioned wiki/documentation index and loop contract.
- Extend the existing GitHub Gate-Fix Loop automation to reconcile these records from exact-SHA GitHub/CI evidence every run.

## Governance
- `IMPLEMENTED` is not `VERIFIED`.
- Exact-SHA evidence required for verified checkpoints.
- No weakened gates, fabricated evidence, or automatic merges.
- GitHub Wiki is currently disabled for this repository; versioned docs are the navigation index until it is enabled.

## Initial residuals
The registry intentionally marks unverified or stale evidence as `IN_PROGRESS`, `BLOCKED`, or `RESIDUAL`; it is an initial inventory, not a claim that all components are verified. PR #48 CI and evidence semantics remain open for re-check.
